title: A Alibi for the Will
author: Lior Coldharbour
blurb: Oscar Halloran, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
